notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
[h1][UPDATE #3][/h1]

[h1][Fixed][/h1]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  - Health bar does not work properly on client

[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  - Sometimes Ratty can carry foods when died

[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  - Some health bar bugs

[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  - Some session joining bugs


[h1][Added][/h1]

[*] [b]Added[/b]  - Bot reload after [b]10 shot[/b] ([b]5 seconds[/b])

[*] [b]Added[/b]  - New [b]air elevator[/b] on [b]Ratty nest[/b]. [b]Ratty nest > Kids Room[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29890282/c7a7ff25d956c56965e96ddd68448589ea63052e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29890282/0776bdb3f9463ad1415e74138a697c4ad976015b.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Added[/b]  - From now on, all [b]Ratties[/b] have [b]3 respawn chance[/b]. (you will be able to [b]enable[/b] / [b]disable[/b] it in the lobby)

[*] [b]Added[/b]  - Added [b]x3 heart[/b] to health bar for representing your lives

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29890282/52746ac23cc686d87566cb49fcecbcd7c3cb98e3.png[/img]

[*] [b]Added[/b]  - Ratty will [b]not be able[/b] to take [b]foods[/b] and [b]revive his friend[/b] when he is in the [b]spy mode in bucket/cardboard box[/b] anymore

notes.title: Major Update! New Map and New Features!
notes.notes:

[h1][Fixed][/h1]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] - Camera clip through ceilings
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  - Now you can reset the car with "R" button if it gets stuck in tutorial
